title: 2 lessons I learned about sales management
description: 2 lessons I learned about sales management
transcript: Two big lessons I've Learned. I've hired, fired, managed 35+ sales people. So number one, somebody who's already done this at a decent level, the higher itself is gonna be 85 90% of it for you. You know, you. You don't need to be managing. And honest to god, you might not even need to be doing call reviews and all the stuff. If you hire somebody good, let it rip. My first hundred, 200,000 dollar a month was doing zero sales management. Absolutely zero. They were just hitting KPI, we were ripping it. It was one rep and me and two. You know, people don't rise to their goals, they fall to their standard. So having one lead, traffic source, one funnel, one application, one video sales letter, one booking, one sales script is gonna make it 10 times easier for this person to come in and perform. Because the majority of sales is repetition.
